about: A web panel for running hosting servers: customers, domains, email, databases and logs.

prs.title: A reseller's log search and cleanup only touch the rows they should
prs.broken: For a reseller, searching the system log ignored the search text for their own rows, and clearing old entries deleted all their customers' log rows, recent ones too.
prs.changed: The part of the query that picks whose rows to read is now grouped, so the search and the age limit apply to every row.
prs.matters: Resellers get correct search results and no longer lose recent customer logs when they clean up.
